description: 1 free call per caller, then $0.0025 USDC via x402 (paid in-band: params._meta["x402/payment"]). DNS lookup over DNS-over-HTTPS (Cloudflare, Google fallback): A, AAAA, MX, NS, TXT, CNAME, CAA, SOA, SRV, HTTPS, DS... for one domain in one call, plus a mail-auth check (MX hosts, SPF, DMARC policy, warnings) and the DNSSEC-validated flag. When to use: Use dns to read any DNS records of a domain and check its mail setup (MX, SPF, DMARC) in one call. Use email-verify to check a single address.
